major_industrial_clusters: Chota Nagpur Plateau, Kalinganagar Belt, Bellary-Hospet, Visakhapatnam Coastal Belt
raw_material_linkages: Iron ore (hematite/magnetite), coking coal, flux-grade limestone, dolomite, manganese
locational_factors: Weight-losing raw material inputs, railway bulk freight routes, access to port locations (Vizag)
leading_states_and_units: Odisha (Rourkela, Kalinganagar), Jharkhand (Tata Jamshedpur, Bokaro), Chhattisgarh (Bhilai), West Bengal (Durgapur, Burnpur)
government_schemes_and_policy: National Steel Policy (targeting 300 MT capacity by 2030), Production Linked Incentive (PLI) Scheme for Specialty Steel
export_contribution_and_gdp_share: Crucial manufacturing foundation, accounts for roughly 2% of India's GDP and employs over 2 million personnel
structural_challenges: Heavy dependence on imported coking coal from Australia, high logistics freight costs, decarbonization requirements (Green Steel transition)

major_industrial_clusters: Mumbai-Pune Belt, Ahmedabad-Surat (Cottonopolis/Manchester of India), Coimbatore-Tirupur ('Knitwear Capital')
raw_material_linkages: Raw seed cotton, pure lint, chemical synthetic dyes, process water
locational_factors: Originally humid coastal climates, raw material proximity, cheap skilled labor, market access (powerlooms shifted to decentralized interiors)
leading_states_and_units: Gujarat, Maharashtra, Tamil Nadu, Telangana, Punjab (Ludhiana hosiery)
government_schemes_and_policy: PM MITRA (Mega Integrated Textile Region and Apparel) Parks Scheme, RoDTEP, Amended Technology Upgradation Fund Scheme (ATUFS)
export_contribution_and_gdp_share: Accounts for around 4% of GDP, 12% of total merchandise export earnings, and is the second largest employment provider after agriculture
structural_challenges: Outdated small-scale machinery in powerlooms, fluctuations in domestic raw cotton yields from pink bollworm pests, tariff competition from Bangladesh and Vietnam

major_industrial_clusters: Hyderabad ('Vaccine Capital / Genome Valley'), Ahmedabad-Vadodara, Baddi-Solan (Himachal Pradesh), Mumbai-Thane
raw_material_linkages: Active Pharmaceutical Ingredients (APIs), key starting materials (KSMs), fine petro-chemicals, glass/polymer packaging
locational_factors: Proximity to research institutions, availability of skilled chemical engineers, industrial chemical infrastructure, state excise incentives
leading_states_and_units: Telangana, Gujarat, Maharashtra, Himachal Pradesh, Andhra Pradesh (Bulk Drug Park Vizag)
government_schemes_and_policy: PLI Scheme for Bulk Drugs and Pharmaceuticals, Promotion of Bulk Drug Parks Scheme, Strengthening of Pharmaceutical Industry (SPI)
export_contribution_and_gdp_share: 'Pharmacy of the World'; supplies over 20% of global generic medicines and 60% of worldwide vaccines
structural_challenges: Over 65% import reliance on China for Active Pharmaceutical Ingredients (APIs), stringent US-FDA regulatory audits, pricing caps on essential medicines

classification: Heavy Chemical / Core Sector / Footloose-Tidewater linked
major_industrial_clusters: Jamnagar-Dahej Belt, Mumbai-Uran, Paradip, Haldia, Panipat, Nagapattinam
raw_material_linkages: Crude petroleum oil, natural gas, naphtha, ethane, cracking chemical catalysts
locational_factors: Tidewater port locations for deep-draft crude supertankers (VLCCs), market pipelines for inland demand centers
leading_states_and_units: Gujarat (Reliance Jamnagar: world's largest refining hub), Maharashtra, Odisha (IOCL Paradip), Haryana (IOCL Panipat)
government_schemes_and_policy: Petroleum, Chemicals and Petrochemical Investment Regions (PCPIR) policy, Hydrocarbon Exploration and Licensing Policy (HELP)
export_contribution_and_gdp_share: Refined petroleum products consistently rank as India's top merchandise export by value
structural_challenges: Over 85% reliance on crude oil imports, exposure to geopolitical supply disruptions, environmental carbon-emission mandates

major_industrial_clusters: Bengaluru ('Silicon Valley of India'), Hyderabad (Cyberabad), Pune, Chennai (OMR IT Corridor), Delhi-NCR (Gurugram/Noida)
raw_material_linkages: Intellectual talent, fiber optic high-bandwidth undersea cables, uninterrupted power arrays, computing cloud servers
locational_factors: Clusters of premier engineering/technical institutions, cosmopolitan urban infrastructure, English-speaking workforce
leading_states_and_units: Karnataka (Infosys, Wipro), Telangana, Maharashtra, Tamil Nadu, Uttar Pradesh/Haryana
government_schemes_and_policy: Software Technology Parks of India (STPI) scheme, National Policy on Software Products, Digital India, IT SEZ tax holidays
export_contribution_and_gdp_share: Generates nearly 7.5% of national GDP, over $200 billion in services exports, and employs over 5 million professionals
structural_challenges: Rapid rise of Generative AI automating baseline coding and call center roles, protectionist H-1B visa policies abroad, talent upskilling demands
